verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a tax agency with online filing and open-data services, but the evidence shows no first-party SDK. The keyless JSON open-data endpoint is served by the data.texas.gov Socrata host platform, and EDI and approved third-party filing software are adjacent channels, not SDKs. OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
